note: Experimental submodule of media_library_media_modify. It adds one field widget, entity_reference_autocomplete_with_override ('Autocomplete (with override)'), for the parent's entity_reference_entity_modify field type; it extends core EntityReferenceAutocompleteWidget and calls the parent EntityReferenceOverrideService::formElement() to add the override button. Only extra setting: form_mode. No routes/permissions/drush of its own; all storage + read-only guard live in the parent. Cases are grounded in that real widget: introspection reads the configured widget type on a live form display; execution builds an entity_reference_entity_modify field using this autocomplete-with-override widget.

evals.prompt: What does the experimental entity_reference_entity_modify submodule add on top of media_library_media_modify, and when would I use it?
evals.expected_output: It adds an autocomplete field widget (entity_reference_autocomplete_with_override) so the parent module's contextual overrides can be used on plain (non-media) entity reference fields, without the media library UI. Use it to give a referenced node/term/etc. per-placement field overrides.

evals.prompt: Which field widget does entity_reference_entity_modify provide, which field type is it for, and what extra setting does it expose?
evals.expected_output: The widget entity_reference_autocomplete_with_override ('Autocomplete (with override)'), offered on entity_reference_entity_modify fields (the parent module's field type). Its only extra setting is form_mode (the override form's form mode).

evals.prompt: What does the entity_reference_entity_modify submodule depend on, and where does the actual override storage logic live?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the parent media_library_media_modify module. All the override storage (overwritten_property_map), render-time application and the read-only save guard live in the parent; this submodule only provides the autocomplete widget front end. It is marked experimental.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article type has a field field_eref_probe that uses this submodule's override-capable autocomplete widget. Inspect the live default form display and state the machine name of the widget configured for it.
evals.expected_output: The widget is entity_reference_autocomplete_with_override, read from core.entity_form_display.node.article.default -> content.field_eref_probe.type.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a field field_eref_task to the Article content type that references nodes and supports contextual overrides (field type entity_reference_entity_modify, target_type node), and configure its default form display to use the entity_reference_entity_modify submodule's 'Autocomplete (with override)' widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create FieldStorageConfig node.field_eref_task type entity_reference_entity_modify (target_type node) + FieldConfig on article, and set the node.article.default form-display component for field_eref_task to widget entity_reference_autocomplete_with_override.
